name: no-slop
description: Keeps generic AI output out of prose, product copy, UI, mobile layout, accessibility and code comments.

interface.shortDescription: Remove generic AI output from text, UI and code comments
interface.longDescription: no-slop filters generic AI output. It routes each task to a focused skill: prose editing that keeps your voice, product copy, web and phone layout, accessibility with a contrast checker, and code comment hygiene. A zero-dependency linter catches the mechanical cases. An audit skill writes a numbered findings file and a PASS or FAIL delivery gate.
